e.summary_en: This is the portal of the Korean insurance industry development institute, an institution that publishes pure premium rates and industry statistics. **Measured this round**: the site returns two hundred with about one hundred fifty kilobytes, and its home page lists in Korean a pure premium rate section, statistical reports, accident status by region, a policy-wording comprehension assessment, disclosure standards, and a knowledge section carrying chief-executive reports, briefs, practice presentations, issue reports, plain-language product explanations, and enterprise insurance; **its English landing page returns two hundred with only one hundred twenty bytes, so the content is in practice Korean only**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of targeted gap filling, because the life insurance category held twenty entries and none of them was a website, and although the site already carries association and statistics entries for one research body, the Japanese life association, the Taiwan insurance centre, and the Korean supervisory service, what it lacks is the rate-making and experience-data side, which is precisely where this institute and the American life insurers council sit.** **Four things are worth reading: it publishes pure premium rates, the same institutional shape as the Japanese non-life rate-making organisation already on the site, showing that in mature markets the shared rates and statistics of competing insurers are handled by a dedicated body; it presents statistical reports alongside accident status, so it is both a statistics publisher and a rate calculator; it also runs a comprehension assessment of policy wordings, which treats whether customers understood the document as a measurable indicator; and its English page is an empty shell, so readers who do not read Korean should approach it through the chart-bearing brief and issue reports instead.** **No report was downloaded and none of its data was used this round.**
e.body:
**KIDI（韩国保险开发院，보험개발원）**（`www.kidi.or.kr`）**是**韩国保险业**的**费率与统计**机构入口****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**按最薄类目定向补**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 站点实测，本次未使用任何数据）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**发布**纯保险费率**（**순보험요율）**，**而**这**在**成熟市场**是**专门**机构的**职责****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**含**「**순보험요율**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条**最值得与**池内**对照的一处**：**⭐ 即**本站**已有 **[[japan-giro]]（**日本**损害保险费率**算出机构）**，**而 **KIDI** 在**韩国**承担**同形**职责**（**汽车保险**与**长期保险**的**费率**与**统计）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**说明**「**费率**由谁**算**」**在**不同**市场**有**不同**制度**安排**：**⭐ 有的**由**各公司**自算**、**有的**由**共用**机构**算**——**⭐ 而**这**直接**决定**「**公开**费率**数据**」**能不能**被**拿到**。

**⭐⭐ ② 统计报告与**事故现况**并列**，**而**条款**理解度**也被**纳入****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**含**「**통계보고서**」（**统计报告）**、**「**광역시도등 사고현황**」（**广域市道等**事故**现况）**、**「**약관등 이해도평가**」（**条款等**理解度**评价）**与**「**공시기준**」（**公示**基准）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**「**条款**理解度**评价**」**这一栏**值得**单独**记**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**消费者**是否**看得懂**条款**」**做成**可**评测**的**项目**——**⭐ 与**本站**一贯**强调的**「**风险沟通**要看**口径**」**同向**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**将来**参与**产品**或**披露**工作**，**这类**评测**通常**比**「**页数**」**更**能**说明**条款**质量**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 知识广场**的内容形态**偏向**「**可**直接**引用**的**短材料****」**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**列出**「**지식광장**」**下**的 **CEO 리포트、**KIDI Brief、**보험실무 발표자료**（**保险实务**发表资料）**、**ISSUE Report、**알기쉬운 보험상품**（**易懂**保险商品）**与**기업성보험**（**企业性**保险）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**这些**材料**对**做**行业**简报**或**课程**作业**的人**很**实用**（**因为**它们**通**常用**图表**把**一个**问题**讲**清）**；**⚠️ 而**它们**不**是**机器可读**数据集**——**⭐ 若**要**做**量化**分析**，**应**另**找**其**统计**报告**的**表格**。

**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 英文页是空壳，**内容**实际**只有**韩语****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**`https://www.kidi.or.kr/eng/`** 返回 **200**、**仅 **120 字节****（**无**正文**），**而**韩语**主页**为 **149,423 字节****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**「**有英文入口**」**与**「**有英文内容**」**是**两件事**——**⭐ 与**本会话**此前**记下的**同类**情形**（**登录墙页 **5,326 字节**、**空壳页 **120 字节）**一致**：**⭐ 判断**一个**机构站点**是否**对外国**读者**可用**，**要**看**英文页**的**正文**字节数**，**而**不**是**看**它**有没有** `/eng/`** 路径**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[japan-giro]] 是**日本**费率**算出机构**、**[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]／**[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]／**[[fss-korea-insurance]] 覆盖**日台韩**的**保险统计**、**[[limra]] 覆盖**美国**寿险**研究**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**韩国**的**费率**与**经验数据**发布方**」这一**缺口**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。**⭐ 并**如实记录**：**本次**同时**核实**了**美国 **ACLI**（**`www.acli.com`** 返回 **200**、**45,144 字节**，**首页逐字含 **ABOUT THE INDUSTRY、**LIFE INSURERS FACT BOOK、**STATE FACT SHEETS 与 **POLICY ISSUES）**，**按**本轮**四条**配额**留作**下轮**候选**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先**问**「**费率**由谁**算**」**，**再**问**「**费率**在哪**看**」**；**② **统计**发布方**往往**同时**是**费率**计算方**；**③ **条款**理解度**可以**被**评测**；**④ **判断**站点**对外国**读者**可用性**要**看**英文页**字节数**；**⑤ **引用**机构**材料**时**标**清**是**短材料**还是**数据集**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**未下载**其任何**报告**或**数据**（**未使用**其**任何**统计**数字**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何**数值**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**首页**返回的**文本**（**经**标签**剥离**与**空白**归一**后的 **4,706 字符**）**与**响应**字节数**，**未**遍历**其**站内**栏目页**，**故**「**栏目**存在**」**只**按**首页**链接**与**文字**记录**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**统计**口径**、**更新**频率**与**下载**授权**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**韩国**监管机构**（**FSS）的**关系**边界**（**⭐ 本词条**只**按**站点**自述**记录**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **英文页**为空壳**为**本次**实测**结论**（**120 字节**）**，**⚠️ 而**站内**个别**英文**材料**是否**存在**，**本次**未逐一**核查**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该站点**是**机构**信息**入口**，**不是**保险产品**，**也**不是**投保建议**。

e.body_en:
This is the portal of the Korean insurance industry development institute, an institution that publishes pure premium rates and industry statistics. **This entry belongs to the round theme of targeted gap filling.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the site itself, with no data used this round**:

**First, it publishes pure premium rates, which in a mature market is the job of a dedicated body.** The home page lists a pure premium rate section, and this is the point most worth setting beside an existing entry for the Japanese non-life rate-making organisation: the institute carries the same institutional role in Korea, computing rates and statistics for motor and long-term insurance. **Who computes rates is arranged differently across markets, some leaving it to individual insurers and others to a shared body, and that arrangement decides whether public rate data can be obtained at all.**

**Second, statistical reports sit alongside accident status, and comprehension of policy wordings is treated as measurable.** The home page lists statistical reports, accident status by region, a policy-wording comprehension assessment, and disclosure standards. **Treating whether a customer understood the wording as an evaluable item lines up with the principle that risk communication depends on definitions, and such assessments usually say more about wording quality than counting pages does.**

**Third, the knowledge section is built from short citable materials.** It lists chief-executive reports, briefs, practice presentations, issue reports, plain-language product explanations, and enterprise insurance materials. **These are convenient for briefings and coursework because they typically explain one question with charts, but they are not machine-readable datasets, so quantitative work should go to the tables in the statistical reports instead.**

**Fourth, the English page is an empty shell, so the content is in practice Korean only.** The English path returns two hundred with only one hundred twenty bytes, against about one hundred fifty kilobytes on the Korean home page. **Having an English entry point and having English content are two different things, and judging whether an institution site is usable for a foreign reader means checking the byte count of the English page body rather than the existence of a path.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: the site already carries the Japanese rate-making body, the Japanese, Taiwanese, and Korean insurance statistics entries, and a United States life research body, **while this entry fills the gap for the Korean rate-making and experience-data publisher. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.** **It also records that the American life insurers council was verified in the same pass, returning two hundred with about forty-five kilobytes and listing an industry overview, a life insurers fact book, state fact sheets, and policy issues, and is being held over as a candidate for the next round to respect this round four-entry quota.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: ask who computes the rates before asking where to read them; note that a statistics publisher is often also the rate calculator; treat wording comprehension as something measurable; judge usability for foreign readers by the English page byte count; and label whether a cited institutional material is a short piece or a dataset.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no report or data was downloaded and no statistic from the site is asserted**. **Second, only the home page text, about forty-seven hundred characters after stripping markup and normalising whitespace, and the response size were read**, so the existence of sections is recorded only from home page links and text, and inner pages were not traversed. **Third, its statistical definitions, update frequency, and download permissions were not verified. Fourth, the boundary of its relationship with the Korean supervisory service was not verified**, this entry recording only what the site says. **Fifth, the empty English page is a measurement from this round**, and whether individual English materials exist inside was not checked item by item. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-12 and states plainly that the site is an institutional information gateway rather than an insurance product or a purchase recommendation.**
